participating in the rating analysis, and that of its client.

11. A credit rating agency shall not make any exaggerated statement, whether

certain services or its achievements with regard to the services rendered to
other clients.

material fact or make any misrepresentation in any documents, reports,
papers or information furnished to the board, stock exchange or public at
